rationale.peakSidecarRssKiB: 512 MiB ceiling for the fixed E11 sidecar workload; not an idle-memory claim.
rationale.postCycleGrowthKiB: At most 64 MiB retained after twelve fixed run/page/release cycles.
rationale.resultCacheBytesAfterRelease: Every fixed result is explicitly released, so no result page bytes may remain.
rationale.hiddenExportStagesAfterCancel: Cancellation must remove the current hidden stage exactly.
